name: Combobox
blurb: A text field that filters a list of options as you type.
mechanism: A real input plus a listbox we own, and about thirty lines of delegated JavaScript for filter, arrows, Escape and click-outside. The zero-JS alternative is `<input list>` + `<datalist>`, whose popup is browser chrome with no CSS hooks in any engine.
caveats: Not a complete ARIA combobox: there is no aria-activedescendant, so a screen reader announces the focused option rather than the input reporting it.
Tab walks the options and Enter picks one; type-ahead inside the list is not implemented.
The datalist version is fully accessible and unstyleable. Pick which of the two matters more for your case.
support: Styling the `<datalist>` popup is not supported in any engine, by design - it is browser chrome.
